title: PPIA-15 Inspector Projection Contracts for Expanded Regression Scenarios

projection_groups.purpose: authorized object identity, duplicate-name disambiguation, target history and conflict state
permission-filtered reveal, hidden/missing equivalence and entitlement-restricted projection
current version, actor-owned stale intent, status and owning-domain allowed recovery choices
Campaign-local override versus inherited/source state with explicit scope and provenance
reusable Definition reference without implying instance, ownership, Campaign or live state
Vehicle ownership, custody, control, access, crew, passenger and cargo relations remain distinct
authorized relationship secret/claim reveal with nonrecipient nonleak equivalence
local draft, submitted operation, approval status, accepted Event and projection lag remain distinct
512-record case-local inventory projection with stable identity, permission-safe aggregates and accessible navigation
128-record case-local Creature/NPC targeting with stable identity and no balance overclaim
known/unknown Species/Form morphology without human defaults or universal compatibility synthesis
bounded offline/read-only, reconnect reauthorization, status-unknown and unsupported source-gap projection

global_rules: Permission and entitlement filtering occurs before protected object resolution and every derivative.
Hidden and missing remain externally equivalent when existence is protected.
A visual projection and its nonvisual projection may differ in layout but not in authorized meaning or disclosure ceiling.
Case-local scale fixture sizes are QA inputs only and do not establish product capacity or performance promises.
Inspector projections are derived views and never create mutation, permission, canonical-content or lifecycle authority.
